titleEn: Tove Jansson’s illustrations for The Hobbit capture the ‘ecstatic truth’ of childhood
titleZh: 托芙·扬松的《霍比特人》插画，如何捕捉童年的想象与真实
method: Machine reference translation with paragraph alignment; not manually certified.

paragraphs.en: Long before I knew Finnish-Swedish author and artist Tove Jansson as the creator of the Moomins, I knew her as a name in the margins of The Annotated Hobbit.
paragraphs.zh: 早在我知道芬兰-瑞典作家和艺术家托芙·扬松是姆明的创造者之前，我就知道她是《注释的霍比特人》边缘的一个名字。

paragraphs.en: Edited by Tolkien scholar Douglas A. Anderson, the book contains explanations of the numerous literary allusions and references to the wider Middle-earth legendarium which dot the landscape of J.R.R. Tolkien’s first novel. It also features more than 150 illustrations from global editions of Tolkien’s beloved classic, including several of Jansson’s for the Swedish translation – En Hobbit’s Äventyr (A Hobbit’s Adventure, 1962).
paragraphs.zh: 这本书由托尔金学者道格拉斯A.安德森（Douglas A. Anderson）编辑，解释了托尔金第一部小说中众多的文学典故，以及对更广阔的中土世界博物馆的参考。这本书还收录了托尔金心爱的经典作品的150多幅全球版本的插图，其中包括几幅扬松为瑞典语翻译的插图--《霍比特人》（En Hobbit）的《艾文提尔》（Äventyr《霍比特人的冒险》（A Hobbit's Adventure，1962）

paragraphs.en: The recent release of The Hobbit: Illustrated by Tove Jansson marks the first time that a full edition of her Tolkien illustrations has appeared in English. And perhaps now the general reader may understand why my child self was so intrigued by them.
paragraphs.zh: 最近出版的《霍比特人：托芙·扬松插图》标志着她的托尔金插图第一次出现在英文版上。也许现在普通读者可以理解为什么我的孩子对它们如此感兴趣。

paragraphs.en: The creator of the Moomins and the maker of Middle-earth may not seem like an obvious pairing, but there are certain parallels between them. Jansson was a Swedish-speaking Finn. Finland’s national epic, The Kalevala (1835), exercised an enormous influence on Tolkien’s legendarium.
paragraphs.zh: 姆明的创造者和中土世界的创造者看起来似乎不是一对明显的搭档，但他们之间有一定的相似之处。扬松是一个讲瑞典语的芬兰人。芬兰的民族史诗《卡勒瓦拉》（1835）对托尔金的《迷宫》产生了巨大的影响。

paragraphs.en: Both Tolkien and Jansson’s respective imaginations were fundamentally shaped by Finnish myth and folklore. Moreover, Tolkien heavily borrowed from what he called the “linguistic aesthetics” of Finnish for his invented Elvish language Quenya.
paragraphs.zh: 托尔金和扬松各自的想象力基本上都是由芬兰神话和民间传说塑造的。此外，托尔金在他发明的精灵语昆亚语中大量借鉴了他所谓的芬兰语“语言美学”。

paragraphs.en: Even bearing this in mind, Jansson’s black-and-white illustrations are very clearly a product of a world before Peter Jackson’s Lord of the Rings trilogy (2001-2003) set the benchmark for visual adaptations of Tolkien’s work.
paragraphs.zh: 即使考虑到这一点，扬森的黑白白色插图是非常清楚的产品之前，彼得杰克逊的指环王三部曲（2001-2003年）设定了托尔金的工作视觉改编的基准。

paragraphs.en: In 1962, fantasy had not yet solidified as a distinct publishing genre. It would take the transformation of The Lord of the Rings into a full-blown cultural phenomenon in the late 1960s to do that. This gave artists greater license to interpret The Hobbit as a standalone work of children’s literature, rather than as a prequel to an epic masterpiece.
paragraphs.zh: 在1962年，奇幻小说还没有成为一种独特的出版类型。这需要《指环王》在20世纪60年代末转变为一种成熟的文化现象。这给了艺术家更大的自由，可以将《霍比特人》解释为一部独立的儿童文学作品，而不是一部史诗杰作的前传。

paragraphs.en: Jansson did not take The Hobbit’s intended audience as an excuse to “soften” her visualisation of Middle-earth, however. In a 1961 essay, she opined that there is an “intense horror sensation […] in every honest children’s book”. As scholar of children’s literature Olga Holownia has explained: “An opportunity to create horror-infused landscapes was Jansson’s key motivation behind taking on the Tolkien commission. She found the scenery ‘seductive in its macabre ferocity’.”
paragraphs.zh: 然而，詹森并没有把《霍比特人》的目标读者作为“软化”她对中土世界想象的借口。在1961年的一篇文章中，她认为“每一本诚实的儿童书中都有一种强烈的恐怖感觉[...]“。正如儿童文学学者奥尔加·霍洛尼亚所解释的那样：“一个创造充满恐怖的风景的机会是Jansson接受托尔金委托的主要动机。她发现风景'在其可怕的凶猛中诱人'。”

paragraphs.en: Jansson’s work on The Hobbit bears this out. Filled with dynamic movement and a sense of the sublime, it showcases a different side of her visual personality, even as its bears her unmistakable artistic imprint.
paragraphs.zh: Jansson的《霍比特人》作品证明了这一点。它充满了动态的运动和崇高感，展示了她视觉个性的另一面，尽管它带有她明确无误的艺术印记。

paragraphs.en: There is more than a hint of Snufkin (the free-spirited wanderer of her Moomin stories) about her Bilbo in his travelling cloak and out-sized hat. But the Misty Mountains are as far from Moominvalley as it’s possible to get, and the ruined gates of the Lonely Mountain resemble the monstrous jaws of Smaug the dragon himself, with plumes of billowing steam and dragon-fire.
paragraphs.zh: 她的比尔博穿着旅行斗篷，戴着超大号的帽子，身上有一丝Snufkin（她的姆明故事中自由奔放的流浪者）的影子。但是迷雾山脉离姆明山谷尽可能远，孤独山的废墟大门就像龙史矛革的巨口，有滚滚的蒸汽和龙火。

paragraphs.en: Here and elsewhere, the characters are literally dwarfed by the landscapes they move through and the creatures they meet there. Consider Jansson’s Gollum. Far from a gnarled, shrunken hobbit, he towers over Bilbo like a slimy cave-troll. Those looking for illustrations that precisely match Tolkien’s words will find themselves disappointed. But I would argue that Jansson captured the “ecstatic truth” of being a small person in a vast and imposing world – that is to say, of being a child.
paragraphs.zh: 在这里和其他地方，角色们与他们所经过的风景和他们在那里遇到的生物相比简直相形见绌。想想詹森的咕噜吧。他就像一个黏糊糊的洞穴巨魔一样耸立在比尔博的上方。那些寻找与托尔金的话完全匹配的插图的人会发现自己很失望。但我认为扬松捕捉到了“狂喜的真相”在一个广阔而壮观的世界里，我是一个小人物，也就是说，我是一个孩子。

paragraphs.en: There is no surviving record of Tolkien’s opinion of Jansson’s work. What we do know is that he was iffy on the idea of fantasy illustration at all. In his seminal essay On Fairy-Stories (1947), he wrote:
paragraphs.zh: 托尔金对扬松作品的看法没有任何现存的记录。我们所知道的是，他对幻想插图的想法根本不确定。在他的开创性文章《论童话故事》（1947）中，他写道：

paragraphs.en: If a story says ‘he climbed a hill and saw a river in the valley below,’ the illustrator may catch, or nearly catch, his own vision of such a scene; but every hearer of the words will have his own picture, and it will be made out of all the hills and rivers and dales he has ever seen, but especially out of The Hill, The River, The Valley which were for him the first embodiment of the word.
paragraphs.zh: 如果一个故事说，“他爬上一座山，看到下面山谷里有一条河，“插图画家可能会抓住，或者几乎抓住，他自己对这样一个场景的看法;但是每个听过这句话的人都会有自己的图片，它将由他见过的所有山丘，河流和山谷组成，但特别是山，河，山谷对他来说是这个词的第一个体现。

paragraphs.en: Tolkien’s stated beliefs about visual art and fantasy hardly stopped him from illustrating his own work. Indeed, since The Hobbit’s publication in 1937, Tolkien’s pictures have become all but canonical.
paragraphs.zh: 托尔金对视觉艺术和幻想的信仰几乎没有阻止他为自己的作品配插图。事实上，自从1937年《霍比特人》出版以来，托尔金的作品几乎成了经典。

paragraphs.en: Anyone who has ever watched Hayao Miyazaki’s Spirited Away (2001) or Guillermo del Toro’s Pan’s Labyrinth (2006) – or, for that matter, Jackson’s Lord of the Rings – will know that visual media possess unique enchantments of their own. So, too, does the work of Tove Jansson.
paragraphs.zh: 任何看过宫崎的《千与千寻》（2001）或吉列尔莫·德尔托罗的《潘神的实验室》（2006）--或者，就此而言，杰克逊的《指环王》--的人都会知道，视觉媒体拥有自己独特的魅力。托芙·扬松的作品也是如此。
